Troubleshooting Guide

Common Issues and Solutions

Issue: Extension not detecting videos

Solutions:

  1. Refresh the webpage completely and wait for videos to load
  2. Ensure the video is not protected by DRM or other copyright protection
  3. Check if the video platform allows downloading
  4. Play it before downloading
  5. Clear browser cache and cookies
  6. Disable other extensions temporarily
Issue: Download speeds are slow

Solutions:

  1. Check your internet connection speed
  2. Try downloading during off-peak hours
  3. Close other browser tabs and applications
  4. Restart your browser and try again

Note: after 30 free high-speed downloads (50 for direct-link downloads and 30 for recordings), the free plan limits stream downloads to 1 connection and direct-link downloads to 2 connections; Pro removes that limit.

Issue: Videos downloaded in low quality

Solutions:

  1. Ensure the original video is available in high quality
  2. Select the highest quality option when downloading
  3. Check if the video platform offers multiple quality options
  4. Clear download cache and retry
Issue: Extension not working on certain websites

Solutions:

  1. Some websites actively block downloaders - this is normal
  2. Check if the video is geo-restricted or age-restricted
  3. Try recording mode or capture mode
  4. Try using the extension on a different website
  5. Update your browser and extension to the latest version
Issue: Downloaded files won't play

Solutions:

  1. Try to fix it with a video repair tool
  2. Try a different video player (VLC Media Player is recommended)
  3. Check if the file downloaded completely
  4. Verify the file format is supported by your device
  5. Re-download the video in a different format

Need Additional Help?

If you're still having issues with the extension, please:

  • Check the browser console for any error messages
  • Ensure you're using the latest version of the extension
  • Try the extension on a different website to isolate the issue
